decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY capturing the newly required selection of compatible LEDs and the resulting supplementation of the approved component set; no additional edit is required.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY capturing the base as a creative focal point, the requested flash and pizazz, and the social-media appearance context.
The source does not change any machine wording, logo, placard content, placement, typography, or other branding requirement.
The client explicitly does not understand the proposed button change and does not approve a new button or control-detail specification; the accepted LED selection belongs to decorative lighting.
The source introduces no change to the established beige and green colors or any component-specific color assignment.
The source discusses LED selection and the visible base aesthetic but does not alter spout geometry, orientation, construction, or beverage-flow constraints.
The source does not change bowl capacity, depth, size, or form.
Compatibility in the source refers to selecting LEDs suitable for the electrical setup, not to whisk size, material, attachment, positioning, or cleaning behavior.
The source does not change bowl removal, swapping, clearance, or cleaning-access behavior.
The requested LEDs and visual embellishments do not necessarily change the existing splash-control target or mitigation methods.

Although the source calls the base highly visible, it does not change the raised platform's height, cup clearance, fit, or structural configuration; its aesthetic treatment is represented by the visual-identity requirement.
Selecting suitable compatible LEDs is consistent with the existing practical component-sourcing policy and does not necessarily revise the V1 approach or its custom-fabrication exceptions.
